notes.note: Northbound land (solid), rail (long dash), sea (dotted), 2025 southbound reverse flow (dash-dot). Lines ending at the border are widened by US Border Patrol apprehensions in that sector in FY2024 (Oct 2023-Sep 2024; 1.53 million across nine sectors, Tucson highest at 463,567). That was the last full year before the collapse: FY2025 fell to 237,565, the lowest since 1970, with only about 65,500 after 20 January 2025, so these corridors now carry a small fraction of FY2024 traffic. Two lines into one sector share its total. Darién width is the 2023 crossing count.
